data.define: Used to agree to a plan or to say okay.

misuse.text: Don't reply 'bet' to your principal's email.
misuse.why: It sounds too casual for formal messages.

data.l1_hook: Pizza lúc sáu giờ, chốt không?

native.tip: “bet” = Chốt luôn, ok nha. Ví dụ: “Pizza at six? Bet.”
native.caption:
“bet” nghĩa là gì?
“bet” = Chốt luôn, ok nha.
Ví dụ: “Pizza at six? Bet.” (Pizza sáu giờ nha? Bet.)
